q: How many parking spaces must a Primary Care Facility provide?
o: 1 for every 50 sq. m. of GFA
1 for every 100 sq. m. of GFA, plus an ambulance/patient transport slot
n: PCFs count parking by floor area; plus a designated ambulance/PTV slot. Remember this: PCF is the "1-100-8-15" clinic: 1 parking per 100 sq. m. GFA, 1 public toilet per 8 patients, 1 staff toilet per 15 personnel. Minor surgery room 12 sq. m. with 3 m side. Ceilings 2.40 (aircon) or 2.70 (natural).
